Hi Jinhee, glad to have found you.
I'm so sorry I'm late.
Oh, don't worry.
I wasn't waiting that long.
I actually arrived early, but I waited in the domestic arrivals area for a while before realizing that international arrivals were in a different terminal.
I've done that before.
Anyway, I have all my bags.
Shall we walk down to the train now?
Okay.
So how was your flight?
It was smooth and I'm happy to be here for the conference.
But I'm a little concerned though.
I just received an email from my co-presenter.
She's not feeling well and won't be able to lead the session with me tomorrow.
